 SSC CPO SI CAPF Revised Exam Date 2026 : Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced the examination schedule for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination 2026. According to the latest available schedule, the SSC CPO Paper-I examination is scheduled to be conducted from November 20 to 28, 2026. Candidates should check the latest official notice for any further changes.
 The online application process closed on September 30, 2026, and the application correction window was open from October 8 to 10, 2026. Candidates preparing for the examination should keep track of the admit card release and other updates through the official SSC website.
 Candidates can also refer to the SSC CPO Exam Date 2026 update for the latest schedule details and information about the examination process.

 SSC CPO SI CAPF Eligibility Criteria 2026
 The educational qualification varies according to the post. Candidates should confirm that they meet the requirements specified in the official notification.
 Educational Qualification for SI in Delhi Police and CAPFs
 Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree from a recognised university or an equivalent qualification to apply for Sub-Inspector posts in Delhi Police and Sub-Inspector (GD) posts in CAPFs.
 Candidates appearing in the final year of their bachelor's degree may also apply, provided they obtain the required qualification by the closing date specified in the official notification.
 Educational Qualification for SI (Fire), CISF
 The eligibility details provided for the SI (Fire), CISF post include the following qualifications:
 A bachelor's degree in Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
 Class 10 qualification along with a three-year diploma in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Automobile, Chemical, Mining, Aeronautical or Telecommunication Engineering, or an equivalent qualification from a recognised institution.
 Higher qualifications such as B.Tech or M.Tech may be considered where the prescribed basic diploma qualification is also held and the official requirements are satisfied.
 Candidates must verify the applicable qualification requirements in the official notification before making any assumptions about their eligibility. They should also check whether additional conditions apply to their selected post.
 For a broader overview of the recruitment, candidates can refer to the SSC CPO 2026 notification and selection process details .
